Let's dive into the world of Tom Brady, the mad bastard who turns 49 today, still leaving opposition defenses wondering if they just got mugged by a football genius or a magician in cleats. Tom Brady isn't just a quarterback; he's a force of nature. You know that mate who somehow wins every pub quiz and the bloody lottery on the same night? That's Brady in the NFL. Born in 1977, this GenX icon redefined the game, mostly because he seemed to treat Super Bowls like a yearly holiday retreat.

The Draft Day Disaster

Back in 2000, Brady got picked 199th in the NFL Draft. Yep, 198 players were chosen before him. It's like turning up to a party and being ignored by everyone until you decide to leave, only to get a standing ovation. Most thought he'd be a benchwarmer, but Brady had other plans. The bloke turned into the GOAT of NFL, leaving every single one of those 198 ahead of him in the dust.

Super Bowl Madness

Seven Super Bowl rings. That's right, seven. More than most teams can dream of. From that first one with the Patriots in 2002 to his most recent victory with the Buccaneers in 2021, Brady's consistency is as baffling as it is brilliant. He won those titles in 2002, 2004, 2005, 2015, 2017, 2019, and 2021, making him a recurring nightmare for opposition coaches.

Ageless Wonder

Most players are retired and sitting on a beach by their mid-thirties, but not Brady. He was breaking records and hearts well into his forties. His secret? A strict diet that includes no tomatoes, among other oddities. A man who can resist pizza is clearly on another level.
